title: Aasmaan larzaa Zameen kaampee Samandar roay
body:
Aasmaan larzaa Zameen kaampee Samandar roay
Qabr mein Maa kay liye jab Ali Asghar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanhaa rothi thi bahaathar ko Ali ki Beti
Bey ridaa jab huvee Zainab tho bahaathar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazaa mein yaad jo Beemar-e-Madina aayeen
Hichkiyaan bandh gayeen istarhaa sey Akbar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Waqt-e-rukhsath jo Hussain aaye dar-e-khaimaa par
Shah Zainab sey bohoth dair lipatt kar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisey royaa na kisee Baap ko Beta koyi
Jaisey chaalees baras Abid-e-Muztar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Zibhaa hotay huvey sab dekh rahi thi behnein
Yeh samaan dekh kay Maula ka muqaddar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisey har Naasir-e-Shabbir pey royee Zainab
Jaisey Bhaayi kay bichardd jaane pey khuaahar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr ka khauff hai gardhan mein rasan bhi hai bandhi
Apney Baba ko Sakina kahaan jaakar roay
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunkay aye Mir Takallum tera majlis mein salaam
Fatima royeen, Ali roay, Payambar roay
